en.answer:
The resolution is performed as per the card text.
(The resolution of『send up to 2 LIGHT Machine monsters from your Deck to the Graveyard』is performed, and『for each monster sent to the Graveyard, this card gains 1 additional attack during each Battle Phase this turn』is also applied.)

If that <<11764>> is changed back to face-up Attack Position after this effect is applied, it can attack up to the number of LIGHT Machine monsters sent to the Graveyard with that effect's resolution, in addition to its normal attack.

Additionally, if that face-up <<11764>> is changed to face-down Defense Position after that effect of <<11764>> is applied, the effect stops applying, and even if it's flipped back face-up after that, it can only attack once as normal.

en.question: If an effect is activated in a chain to the『Once per turn: You can send up to 2 LIGHT Machine monsters from your Deck to the Graveyard, and if you do, for each monster sent to the Graveyard, this card gains 1 additional attack during each Battle Phase this turn』effect of <<11764>> and that <<11764>> is changed to face-down Defense Position, what happens to the resolution?
en.title: If, due to an effect activated in a chain to an effect that allows a monster to attack multiple times, that monster has been changed to face-down Defense Position when it resolves, what happens to the resolution?

ja.answer:
処理はテキスト通りに行われます。
（『デッキから機械族・光属性モンスターを２体まで墓地へ送る』処理を行い、『この効果で墓地へ送ったモンスターの数まで１度のバトルフェイズ中に攻撃できる』も適用されます。）

この効果の適用後、その「<<11764>>」が、そのターンに表側攻撃表示に戻ったのであれば、通常の攻撃に加えて、その効果の処理で墓地へ送った機械族・光属性モンスターの数まで攻撃できます。

なお、その「<<11764>>」の効果の適用後に、その「<<11764>>」が表側表示から裏側守備表示になった場合には、効果の適用はなくなりますので、その後表側表示に戻っても、通常通り１回しか攻撃できません。
